**Big but mostly safe: 1025 of 1082 hits are internal.** 94 files total.

| Zone | Hits | Files | Rename? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `services/**` http/repo/service | 1025 | 75 | Yes |
| `migrations/**` | 37 | 12 | No, applied history |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | 1 | No, public contract |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 12 | 4 | No, overwritten by `vendor:refresh` |
| `lib/serialize.js` wire value | 1 | 1 | No, left key only |

Two traps. The SQL column stays `account_id` unless a new migration renames it. So strings inside `repo/*.js` cannot flip with the variables. And `lib/audit.js` writes an `account_id` log field that dashboards may query.

Ask them which they mean: variables only, or column too.
